label: No infinite actual esse-cause regress, from grounding well-founded on actual concreta (inference)
rule: Transfer well-foundedness along a predecessor inclusion (wellFounded_of_predecessorInclusion)
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation, one profile m, one reading world w and one q.3 a.4 profile p over the same carrier of beings. If the selected grounding relation is well-founded among actual concreta at w (82cfaf26), a distinct cause of the esse of an actual concretum is an actual concrete ground of it at w (cb1cdea9), whatever is in act of esse exists at w (546975ef) and whatever has esse in re is concrete in the profile (2d9807a5), then the relation 'c, in act and other than x, causes the esse of x, which is in act' (ActualEsseCause) is well-founded (fd12ad3d). Step: for an actual cause c of x, x is in act, so by the two calibrations x is an actual concretum; by the esse-cause bridge c is then concrete, exists at w and grounds x; so every actual-cause predecessor is a grounding predecessor among actual concreta, and well-foundedness transfers (the successor need not be an actual concretum). No new premise: the read-only survey's claim that one further inclusion bridge suffices is corrected; besides the esse-cause bridge cb1cdea9 the derivation needs the two actuality calibrations, which no other De ente premise supplies. Through the existing strength order 80f81d44 it also gives the per se regress ea251340. The closed controls esseRegressControls give, for each of the four inputs, a one-world Bool interpretation in which the other three hold and the regress fails, and a nonvacuous interpretation with an actual cause of being; ascentLimit (attached here) is a Nat interpretation in which actual grounding, the esse regress, well-founded priority, the four inclusions cb1cdea9, 98efaa9e, 86efed1a and d96105fb (ground into more in esse) and the genus principle d9fad785 (vacuously, since the grade has no maximum) hold while the quarta via's no-infinite-ascent premise fails, even among actual concreta; grounding, causing and priority there are the single edge 1 -> 0. These are facts about the stated interpretations only. The conclusion inherits whatever warrant AGWF and the three bridges have; it is a support option alongside fd12ad3d's direct and per se options, not a defence of any input.
